effects.display_name: Wither Aura native repeated-enchantment-query status profiles
effects.actual_behavior: Causing CURRENT main-hand arphex:wither_aura level first queried !=0 admits outer package. Native repeats the item/enchantment query independently: query==0 requests server victim Wither60/0;query==1 requests Wither60/0 then Darkness60/0;query>=2 requests Wither60/1 then Darkness60/0. All native three-argument constructors,results ignored. The zero requery branch has contradictory predicates under a stable query value,but the code DOES call the getter again; no synthetic level0 normal profile,constant query guarantee,semantic rewrite or fuzzy level mapping is imposed. Native item/enchantment hooks determine queried levels. Darkness amplifier0 is binary metadata,not a magnitude. No original hurt-success check. Exact NeoForge21.1.244 IItemStackExtension.getEnchantmentLevel calls native Item.getEnchantmentLevel then EventHooks.getEnchantmentLevelSpecific on EACH read. With an unwrapLookup the hook creates mutable enchantment levels,posts GetEnchantmentLevelEvent,then returns mutable.getLevel; without lookup it returns the supplied level. Repeated reads therefore are not guaranteed stable by the native API. The guarded zero-requery request is conditional native code,not proven dead or a normal base-level0 profile.
